mainTopic: The opening in the large מערכה, the end of ראוהו אחיו, and the start of the next chapter: the lottery for the תמיד jobs and the morning preparations
overview: The amud opens by finishing a description of how growers made trees produce heavy beam-wood instead of fruit. The גמרא then turns to the משנה about the large מערכה on the מזבח, which had an opening on its east side, and asks why. רב הונא and רב חסדא disagree: one says the opening let the wind fan the fire, and the other says the כהנים lit the kindling from there. The גמרא challenges the second view, because the משנה says the kindling was lit from gaps between the logs. It answers that the כהנים lit it from many places. The chapter ראוהו אחיו then ends with the הדרן. A new chapter begins with a משנה. The ממונה holds a lottery for the morning jobs of the תמיד, including the nine portions carried to the כבש. Then the כהנים check for dawn, using either the call ברקאי or, according to מתיא בן שמואל, a question about the light reaching חברון. They bring a lamb from the לשכת הטלאים, one of four chambers in that building, take out ninety-three vessels, and give the lamb water from a cup.

steps.title: How growers produce thick, heavy wood
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא finishes describing how growers treat certain trees so that they give strong wood for beams instead of fruit.
steps.simpleTranslation: They rub the trees with a rope made of palm fibers that has seeds stuck to it, and they plant them where the sea brings up sediment. Such a tree produces wood good for a beam, but it does not produce fruit. Its wood is so heavy that a camel cannot carry three of its branches.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is finishing a description of a special growing method that makes trees grow heavy, beam-quality wood.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The tree does not put its strength into fruit, so all of its growth goes into the wood. The result is wood so dense and heavy that just three branches are too much for a camel to carry.

keyTerms.meaning: A rope made of palm fibers
Seeds
Sediment or silt that the sea deposits
A wooden beam
Branches

phrases.english: And they rub them with a rope of palm fiber
that has seeds stuck to it,
and they plant them in a place
where the sea brings up sediment.
It produces a beam,
but it does not produce fruit.
And three branches of them
a camel cannot carry.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Continues a description that began before this section.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Trees grown this way produce heavy beam-wood and no fruit.

steps.title: Why did the large woodpile have an opening?
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא quotes the משנה about arranging the large מערכה, which had an opening on its east side, and asks why.
steps.simpleTranslation: The משנה says: He arranged the large מערכה, and so on. What is the reason for this?
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא returns to a line of the משנה and asks for the reason behind it. This sets up the next step, where two אמוראים answer.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The משנה describes the large מערכה with its opening on the east side, but it does not say why the opening was needed. The question is about the purpose of that opening.

keyTerms.meaning: The large woodpile on the מזבח, where the offerings were burned
"Etc.": the rest of the quoted line is not written out
What is the reason?

phrases.english: He arranged the large arrangement, etc.
phrases.notes: This quotes the משנה, which goes on to say that the opening of the woodpile faced east.

phrases.english: What is the reason?

steps.triggerLanguage: סִידֵּר אֶת הַמַּעֲרָכָה גְּדוֹלָה וְכוּ׳. מַאי טַעְמָא?
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A new topic. The גמרא goes back to the next line of the משנה.
steps.sheelahInformationSought: The purpose of the opening on the east side of the large מערכה.

steps.title: Two answers: for the wind, or for lighting the kindling
steps.stepSummary: רב הונא and רב חסדא disagree. One says the opening let the wind blow in, and the other says it let the כהנים light the kindling from there.
steps.simpleTranslation: רב הונא and רב חסדא disagree about this. One said: so that the wind would blow into it. The other said: so that they could light the kindling from there.
steps.whatsHappening: Two אמוראים give different reasons for the opening in the מערכה.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In the first view, the opening is there to help the fire, since the wind fans the flames. In the second view, the opening is a place to reach in and light the small kindling. We are not told which אמורא holds which view.

keyTerms.meaning: Blowing (said of wind)
Small kindling twigs used to start the fire
They light or ignite

steps.confusionAlert: Don't assume that the first view belongs to רב הונא just because he is named first. The גמרא only says "one said" and "one said."

phrases.english: Rav Huna and Rav Chisda disagree.
One said: so that
the wind would blow into it.
And one said: so that they would
light the kindling from there.

steps.triggerLanguage: רַב הוּנָא וְרַב חִסְדָּא. חַד אָמַר
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Answers the question asked in step 2.
steps.teshuvahAnswerProvided: View A: the opening lets in wind. View B: the opening is for lighting the kindling.

steps.title: Challenge: the kindling was lit from spaces between the logs
steps.stepSummary: The גמרא challenges the second view. The משנה says the kindling was lit from spaces between the logs, not from the opening.
steps.simpleTranslation: An objection was raised: There was space between the logs, because they would light the kindling from there.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings a source showing that the kindling was lit from gaps between the logs. This seems to argue against the view that the east opening was for lighting.
steps.deeperAnalysis: If the kindling was lit through the spaces between the logs, then the opening was not needed for lighting. That would leave only the wind view standing.

keyTerms.meaning: Space or gap
Logs of wood

phrases.english: They raised an objection: There was space in them
between the logs,
for they would light the kindling from there.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Attacks the second answer in step 3.
steps.kashyaTarget: The view that the east opening was for lighting the kindling.
steps.kashyaAttackLogic: The משנה places the lighting at the gaps between the logs, so the opening seems unnecessary for lighting.

steps.title: Answer: they made openings in many places
steps.stepSummary: The second view can answer that the כהנים made lighting spots in many places: the east opening and the gaps between the logs.
steps.simpleTranslation: He can say to you: they made several places for lighting.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא defends the second view by explaining that the kindling was lit from many openings, not just one.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Both sources can be true together. The kindling was lit from the east opening and also from gaps between the logs, so the משנה does not disprove the second view.

keyTerms.meaning: He can say to you (a defense on behalf of the view that was challenged)
Many places, in several spots

steps.whatToRemember: The opening in the large מערכה was either for wind or for lighting. The lighting view stands, because the kindling was lit from many places.

phrases.english: He can say to you:
they made many places.
phrases.notes: He means many openings for lighting: the east opening and the gaps between the logs.

steps.terutzResolutionType: Both sources describe lighting spots that existed side by side.
steps.terutzHavaAmina: Since the kindling was lit from the gaps, the opening could not have been for lighting.
steps.terutzMaskana: Lighting happened in several places, including the east opening.

steps.title: הדרן: closing the chapter ראוהו אחיו
steps.stepSummary: The chapter ראוהו אחיו ends with the traditional closing formula.
steps.simpleTranslation: We will return to you, ראוהו אחיו.
steps.whatsHappening: This is the closing line marking the end of the chapter ראוהו אחיו.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The הדרן is said at the end of every chapter. It expresses the hope to come back and learn this chapter again.

keyTerms.meaning: "We will return to you": the formula said at the end of a chapter

phrases.english: We will return to you, "His brethren saw him"

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Closes the chapter after the last discussion.
steps.maskanaFinalTakeaway: The chapter ראוהו אחיו is complete.

steps.title: The appointed כהן calls the lottery for the morning jobs
steps.stepSummary: The ממונה tells the כהנים to hold a פיס for slaughtering, sprinkling the blood, cleaning the inner מזבח, cleaning the מנורה, and bringing the limbs to the כבש.
steps.simpleTranslation: The appointed one said to them: Come and cast lots for who slaughters, who sprinkles the blood, who cleans the ashes from the inner altar, who cleans the מנורה, and who brings the limbs up to the ramp.
steps.whatsHappening: A new פרק opens with a משנה. The ממונה gathers the כהנים and holds a lottery to decide who does each job for the morning תמיד.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each Temple job is a privilege, so the jobs are handed out by lottery to keep things fair. This line lists the main tasks. The next line spells out exactly which limbs are carried up.

keyTerms.meaning: The appointed officer in charge of the כהנים' daily jobs
Cast lots / the lottery used to give out Temple jobs
Clears out the ashes
The inner (golden) altar used for קטורת
The ramp leading up to the outer מזבח

phrases.english: The appointed one said to them:
Come and cast lots:
who slaughters, and who sprinkles,
phrases.notes: 'Sprinkles' means sprinkling the animal's blood on the מזבח.

phrases.english: who clears the ashes of the inner altar,
who cleans out the menorah,
who brings the limbs up to the ramp.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new פרק right after the הדרן in step 6.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The morning jobs of the תמיד are given out by a פיס run by the ממונה.

steps.title: How the limbs and offerings are split among the kohanim
steps.stepSummary: The משנה lists the parts carried to the כבש: head and right leg, two forelegs, haunch and left leg, breast and neck, two flanks, innards, flour, griddle cakes, and wine.
steps.simpleTranslation: The head and the right leg; the two forelegs; the haunch and the left leg; the breast and the neck; the two flanks; the innards; the fine flour; the griddle cakes; and the wine.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה explains what 'bringing the limbs to the כבש' from step 7 includes. It lists each part, or pair of parts, that a different כהן carries.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Each group in the list is a separate job for its own כהן. Besides the animal's limbs, the list also covers the מנחה flour, the חביתין, and the wine for the נסכים. So 'bringing up the limbs' is really nine separate jobs.

keyTerms.meaning: The haunch, the back end of the spine with the tail
The breast
The neck with the windpipe and the organs attached to it
The innards
The כהן גדול's daily griddle-cake offering

phrases.english: The head and the right leg;
and the two forelegs;
the haunch and the left leg;
the breast and the neck;
phrases.notes: גרה literally means 'cud.' Here it means the neck along with the windpipe and the organs hanging from it.

phrases.english: and the two flanks;
the innards; and the fine flour;
and the griddle cakes, and the wine.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Spells out the 'limbs to the כבש' job from step 7.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The limbs, flour, griddle cakes and wine are divided into nine portions, each carried by a different כהן.

steps.title: The lottery is held
steps.stepSummary: The כהנים cast lots, and whoever won got the job.
steps.simpleTranslation: They cast lots, and whoever won, won.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה reports that the lottery actually took place and the winners got their jobs.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Steps 7 and 8 listed the jobs. This line closes the lottery section. The משנה now moves on to the next stage of the morning: checking whether it is time to slaughter.

keyTerms.meaning: Won, earned the right to the job

phrases.english: They cast lots; whoever won, won.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Carries out the lottery that was announced in steps 7 and 8.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The jobs go to the winners of the פיס.

steps.title: Checking if it is time to slaughter
steps.stepSummary: The ממונה sends someone out to see whether the time for שחיטה has arrived. If it has, the watcher calls out 'ברקאי'.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to them: Go out and see if the time for slaughtering has come. If it has, the one who looks says: 'ברקאי!'
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה moves to the next stage. Before slaughtering the תמיד, someone must check that daylight has come.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The תמיד cannot be slaughtered before daytime, so they need a clear signal that morning has arrived. The watcher reports with a set word, 'ברקאי', which means the sky is getting light.

keyTerms.meaning: The time when the תמיד may be slaughtered, which is daytime
An Aramaic call meaning 'it is getting light'

phrases.english: He said to them: Go out and see
if the time for slaughtering has arrived.
If it has arrived, the one watching says: 'Barkai!'
phrases.notes: ברקאי is a short Aramaic way of saying 'there's light' or 'dawn is breaking.'

steps.triggerLanguage: אָמַר לָהֶן: צְאוּ וּרְאוּ אִם הִגִּיעַ זְמַן שְׁחִיטָה
steps.relationToPreviousStep: After the lottery, the משנה moves to the next stage of the morning service.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: They do not slaughter until a watcher confirms it is daytime by calling 'ברקאי'.
steps.whyThisMatters: It shows that the תמיד may only be slaughtered once day has truly begun.

steps.title: מתיא בן שמואל's version of the dawn check
steps.stepSummary: מתיא בן שמואל says the question was 'Is the whole eastern sky lit up as far as חברון?' and the watcher answered 'Yes.'
steps.simpleTranslation: מתיא בן שמואל says: The question was, 'Has the whole eastern sky lit up as far as חברון?' And the watcher says: 'Yes.'
steps.whatsHappening: מתיא בן שמואל gives a different version of the wording used to check for daylight.
steps.deeperAnalysis: In step 10 the watcher simply called out 'ברקאי'. According to מתיא בן שמואל, the ממונה asked a specific question about the light reaching as far as חברון, and the watcher just answered 'yes.' Both versions agree that they check for daylight. They differ only in how the exchange was worded.

keyTerms.meaning: Lit up, became bright
The whole face of the eastern sky
Yes

steps.whatToRemember: Before the תמיד is slaughtered, they confirm it is daytime. The תנא קמא uses the call 'ברקאי'. מתיא בן שמואל uses a question about the light reaching חברון, answered with 'הן'.

phrases.english: Matya ben Shmuel says:
'Has the whole eastern sky lit up
all the way to Hebron?'
phrases.notes: This is the question the ממונה asks, not the watcher's report.

phrases.english: And he answers: 'Yes.'

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives a different version of how the dawn check in step 10 was worded.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to מתיא בן שמואל, the ממונה asks whether the light has reached as far as חברון, and the watcher answers 'yes.'

steps.title: The ממונה orders the כהנים to bring a lamb
steps.stepSummary: After dawn is confirmed, the ממונה tells the כהנים to go and bring a lamb from the לשכת הטלאים.
steps.simpleTranslation: He said to them: Go out and bring a lamb from the Chamber of Lambs.
steps.whatsHappening: Now that the sky is light enough for שחיטה, the ממונה gives the next order: bring the lamb for the תמיד.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Steps 10 and 11 checked whether it was time to slaughter. Once the watcher said 'yes,' the work moves from waiting to acting. The first thing needed is the animal itself.

keyTerms.meaning: A lamb (here, the one used for the morning תמיד)
The Chamber of Lambs, where approved lambs were kept

phrases.english: He said to them:
phrases.notes: 'He' is the ממונה, the official in charge from the earlier steps.

phrases.english: Go out and bring (me, and take out)
phrases.notes: Some versions leave out the words in round brackets. The meaning stays the same: go get a lamb.

phrases.english: a lamb from the Chamber of Lambs.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Follows the confirmation that dawn has arrived, so the תמיד can now be brought.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: Once dawn is confirmed, the ממונה orders a lamb brought from the לשכת הטלאים.

steps.title: Where the lamb chamber was, and the four chambers there
steps.stepSummary: The משנה places the לשכת הטלאים in the northwest corner and lists the four rooms that stood there together.
steps.simpleTranslation: The Chamber of Lambs was in the northwest corner. There were four chambers there: the Chamber of Lambs, the Chamber of Seals, the Chamber of the בית המוקד, and the chamber where they made the לחם הפנים.
steps.whatsHappening: The משנה pauses to tell us where the lamb room was. It also names the other three rooms that were in the same area.
steps.deeperAnalysis: This is a short description of the building's layout, not a new law. It shows the learner where the כהנים had to walk to get the lamb. It also names the rooms that stood next to it.

keyTerms.meaning: A corner
The Chamber of Seals
The House of the Fire, a room with a fire where the כהנים kept warm
The showbread placed on the שולחן each שבת

phrases.english: And the Chamber of Lambs
was located in the northwest corner.
Four chambers were there:
one, the Chamber of Lambs;
and one, the Chamber of Seals;
and one, the Chamber of the House of the Fire;

phrases.aramaic: וְאַחַת – לִשְׁכָּה שֶׁעוֹשִׂין בָּהּ לֶחֶם הַפָּנִים.
phrases.english: and one, the chamber in which they make the showbread.

steps.triggerLanguage: וַהֲרֵי לִשְׁכַּת הַטְּלָאִים נְתוּנָה בְּמִקְצוֹעַ צְפוֹנִית מַעֲרָבִית
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Explains where the chamber mentioned in step 12 was located.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The לשכת הטלאים was in the northwest corner, one of four chambers there.

steps.title: Taking out the vessels and watering the תמיד
steps.stepSummary: A new משנה: the כהנים take ninety-three silver and gold vessels from the vessel room and give the תמיד lamb water to drink from a cup.
steps.simpleTranslation: They entered the Chamber of Vessels and took out ninety-three silver and gold vessels. They gave the תמיד water to drink from a cup.
steps.whatsHappening: A new משנה starts here. The כהנים collect all the vessels needed for the day's service and give the lamb a drink.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Now that the lamb is chosen, the next step is getting the tools ready, so the vessels come out all at once. Giving the lamb water from a cup is also part of preparing it before שחיטה.

keyTerms.meaning: The Chamber of Vessels, where the service vessels were stored
Silver vessels and gold vessels
They gave to drink
The daily communal offering, brought each morning and afternoon

steps.whatToRemember: The order is: confirm dawn, bring the lamb, take out the vessels, then water the lamb before שחיטה.

phrases.english: They entered the Chamber of Vessels,
they took out from there

phrases.aramaic: תִּשְׁעִים וּשְׁלֹשָׁה כְּלֵי כֶסֶף וּכְלֵי זָהָב,
phrases.english: ninety-three silver vessels and gold vessels,
they gave the daily offering water to drink in a cup

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new משנה that continues the morning routine after the lamb is brought.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: The כהנים take ninety-three silver and gold vessels from the vessel room and give the תמיד water to drink from a cup.
